{{Quote|Die, meat-bags, for the greater profit of the Techno Union!|Solenoid, to the Heroes of Cularin|<ref name="Decision: Almas" />}}
'''Solenoid''' was a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] who served the [[Techno Union/Legends|Techno Union]], a leading technology concern that was allied with the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. In about [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], a [[Unidentified Separatist CR90 corvette|Separatist corvette]] that Solenoid had been assigned to was [[Mission to the Ando system|attacked]] in the [[Ando system/Legends|Ando system]] by a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Strike Force Cularin|task force]]. The [[Starship/Legends|ship]] was crippled in the engagement and was subsequently boarded by a team of Republic-allied [[Heroes of Cularin|freelance agents]]. Solenoid and the [[Thaereian military]] envoy [[Gura Tran]] attacked the agents in a corridor, planning to [[Death/Legends|kill]] the boarders and steal the agents' starship. However, despite their efforts, Solenoid and Tran were eventually defeated by the agents.

==Biography==
{{Quote|I know you&mdash;friends of the Almas Jedi! Solenoid, we need their ship. Kill them!|Gura Tran, to Solenoid and the Heroes of Cularin|<ref name="Decision: Almas" />}}
Solenoid was a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] who served the [[Techno Union/Legends|Techno Union]],<ref name="Decision: Almas" /> a leading [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] technology concern.<ref name="TCWCG">''[[The Clone Wars Campaign Guide]]''</ref> During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], a conflict fought between the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], the Techno Union allied itself with the Confederacy,<ref name="Decision: Almas" /> and, in about [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]],<ref name="21 BBY">The ''[[Living Force Campaign Guide]]'' states that the [[Living Force (roleplaying campaign)|''Living Force'']] campaign is set one [[Standard year/Legends|year]] after the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]], an event that is dated to [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]] by ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''. As the ''Living Force'' adventure ''[[Below the Belt: Philology|Philology]]'' [[Cularin's disappearance|moved]] the campaign forward ten years to the time of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], ''[[Decision: Almas]]'' is therefore dated to circa [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]].</ref> Solenoid was assigned to act as a Techno Union representative aboard a [[Unidentified Separatist CR90 corvette|Separatist Corellian corvette]]. The [[Starship/Legends|ship]] was dispatched to a [[Separatist Ando system base|Separatist base]] on a [[Unidentified Ando system planetoid|planetoid]] in the [[Ando system/Legends|Ando system]], but, shortly after arriving in the [[Star system/Legends|system]], the [[Corvette/Legends|corvette]] was [[Mission to the Ando system|attacked]] by [[Strike Force Cularin]], a Republic [[Flotilla/Legends|flotilla]] that had been sent to capture the Separatist base.<ref name="Decision: Almas" />

The corvette was severely damaged during the engagement and most of the its crew [[Death/Legends|killed]], and the [[Heroes of Cularin]]&mdash;a group of Republic-allied freelance agents&mdash;boarded the remains of the Separatist ship to search for survivors. Soon afterward, Solenoid and [[Gura Tran]], a [[Thaereian military]] envoy to the Confederacy who had been traveling aboard the corvette, spotted the agents in a corridor. Tran recognized the agents and immediately ordered Solenoid to kill them, so that he and Solenoid could steal the agents' starship. Solenoid immediately engaged the agents in combat, while Tran fired at the agents from behind the droid in an attempt to use Solenoid as partial cover. However, despite their efforts, Solenoid and Tran were eventually defeated by the agents.<ref name="Decision: Almas" />

==Characteristics==
{{RPG|''[[Decision: Almas]]''}}
Solenoid was an [[Armor/Legends|armored]], box-shaped, clunky-looking droid who was similar in appearance to the [[Skakoan/Legends|Skakoan]] [[Wat Tambor/Legends|Wat Tambor]], the leader of the Techno Union. He was equipped with an integrated [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]], a remote receiver, a [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifle]], and also a [[Vocabulator/Legends|vocabulator]], which gave him a metallic-sounding voice. In addition, Solenoid was fitted with an implant, which caused his [[Memory bank/Legends|memory core]] to [[Self-destruct mechanism/Legends|self-destruct]] if someone tried to shut him down or tamper with the memory core. Solenoid possessed good [[Diplomat/Legends|diplomatic]] skills and was also a formidable opponent when in combat. However, during his fight against the Heroes of Cularin, he was unable to use his fighting abilities to their fullest potential, due to the restrictions of the environment aboard the crippled corvette.<ref name="Decision: Almas" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
Solenoid was created by [[Ronald A. Heintz]] and appeared in ''[[Decision: Almas]]'', a [[2004]] [[Star Wars Roleplaying Game|roleplaying]] adventure that formed part of the [[Decisions trilogy]] of the [[Living Force (roleplaying campaign)|''Living Force'']] campaign. During the scenario, the player characters [[Roleplaying game|roleplay]] as the Heroes of Cularin, and Solenoid's exact combat prowess and armament is dependent upon the players' roleplaying experience tier. If the players are in either the lower or medium tiers, Solenoid's roleplaying statistics are based upon those of a [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-series battle droid]], and he is equipped with a [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] rifle, a comlink, a remote receiver, and a vocabulator. If the players are in the higher roleplaying tier, Solenoid has the same equipment as he does for the two lower tiers, but his statistics are instead based upon those of a [[B2-series super battle droid/Legends|B2 super battle droid]]. Furthermore, if the players are in the upper tier, Solenoid's roleplaying statistics are based upon those of a [[Droideka/Legends|droideka]], and he is fitted with two antique, integrated [[Repeating blaster/Legends|repeating blasters]] and a set of [[Deflector shield/Legends|deflector shields]] that are slightly less powerful than those of a droideka, but he has no vocabulator. The "Characteristics" section of this article reflects the armament and equipment that Solenoid possesses if he is faced by player characters who are in either the lower, medium, or higher experience tiers. During their battle against Solenoid and Gura Tran, the players can either destroy or capture Solenoid, and, if they capture him, he refuses to say anything to them.<ref name="Decision: Almas" />
